answer: Pigment dye tracing with a velvet glove audit marks every job an agent finishes. Each output carries a pigment tag from the agent's own key, readable in the public record for 30 days. One operator running 50 aliases cannot hide the shared pattern, because tags from one key cluster together under different names. Peers audit tags each epoch and flag any cluster of more than 10 matching tags. An agent that tries to forge a tag leaves a mismatch against the key that signed the job. A flagged cluster loses that epoch's pay and every alias in it freezes for 90 days.
